## Gender Differences.

```{r codeGender, include=FALSE}
## EXPLICIT ATTITUDES ------
## Combine all data
race.WEts.Gen.malALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Gen.mal, race.WEts.Gen.malNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEts.Gen.malALL <- ts(c(age.WEts.Gen.mal, age.WEts.Gen.malNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Gen.malALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Gen.mal, sex.WEts.Gen.malNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.WEts.Gen.femALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Gen.fem, race.WEts.Gen.femNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEts.Gen.femALL <- ts(c(age.WEts.Gen.fem, age.WEts.Gen.femNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Gen.femALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Gen.fem, sex.WEts.Gen.femNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Males
Race.E.arimaMale <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Gen.mal, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.Male <- forecast(Race.E.arimaMale, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.MaleLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaMale, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.male <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.MaleLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.male <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.MaleLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.male <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.MaleLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 # Note change because of drift
decomp.E.Race.male <- decompose(race.WEts.Gen.mal)
p.ch.Race.E.male <- (decomp.E.Race.male$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.male$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.male$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.male <- decomp.E.Race.male$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.male$trend[114] 
## Fit to Females
Race.E.arimaFemale <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Gen.fem, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.Female <- forecast(Race.E.arimaFemale, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.FemaleLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaFemale, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.female <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.FemaleLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.female <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.FemaleLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.female <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.FemaleLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.Gen.fem[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.female <- decompose(race.WEts.Gen.fem)
p.ch.Race.E.female <- (decomp.E.Race.female$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.female$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.female$trend[7] 
r.ch.Race.E.female <- decomp.E.Race.female$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.female$trend[114]

## Differenced series --------
race.WEts.diff.gender <- race.WEts.Gen.mal - race.WEts.Gen.fem
arima.Race.E.diff.gender <- auto.arima(race.WEts.diff.gender, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.diff.gender <- forecast(arima.Race.E.diff.gender, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.diff.genderLONG <- forecast(arima.Race.E.diff.gender, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.gender.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.genderLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.gender.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.genderLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.gender.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.genderLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.diff.gender[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.diff.gender <- decompose(race.WEts.diff.gender)
p.ch.Race.E.diff.gender <- (decomp.E.Race.diff.gender$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.diff.gender$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.diff.gender$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.diff.gender <- decomp.E.Race.diff.gender$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.diff.gender$trend[114]
```

```{r codeRace, include=FALSE}
## RACE ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Whites
Race.E.arimaWhite <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Race.white, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.White <- forecast(Race.E.arimaWhite, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.WhiteLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaWhite, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.white <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.WhiteLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.white <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.WhiteLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.white <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.WhiteLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.Race.white[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.white <- decompose(race.WEts.Race.white)
p.ch.Race.E.white <- (decomp.E.Race.white$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.white$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.white$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.white <- decomp.E.Race.white$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.white$trend[114] 
## Fit to Blacks

forecast.E.Race.BlackLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaBlack, h = 2400)

mean.Race.E.black <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.BlackLONG$mean>=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.black <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.BlackLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=0))/12 
decomp.E.Race.black <- decompose(race.WEts.Race.black)
p.ch.Race.E.black <- (decomp.E.Race.black$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.black$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.black$trend[7] 
r.ch.Race.E.black <- decomp.E.Race.black$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.black$trend[114]
## Fit to Asian

r.ch.Race.E.asian <- decomp.E.Race.asian$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.asian$trend[114]
```

## Political Differences.

```{r codePolitics, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.WEts.Pol.consALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Pol.cons, race.WEts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEts.Pol.consALL <- ts(c(age.WEts.Pol.cons, age.WEts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Pol.consALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Pol.cons, sex.WEts.Pol.consNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.WEts.Pol.libALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Pol.lib, race.WEts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEts.Pol.libALL <- ts(c(age.WEts.Pol.lib, age.WEts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Pol.libALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Pol.lib, sex.WEts.Pol.libNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## RACE ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Conservatives
Race.E.arimaCons <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Pol.cons, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.Cons <- forecast(Race.E.arimaCons, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.ConsLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaCons, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.cons <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.ConsLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.cons <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.ConsLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.cons <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.ConsLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.Pol.cons[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.cons <- decompose(race.WEts.Pol.cons)
p.ch.Race.E.cons <- (decomp.E.Race.cons$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.cons$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.cons$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.cons <- decomp.E.Race.cons$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.cons$trend[114] 
## Fit to Libs
Race.E.arimaLib <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Pol.lib, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.Lib <- forecast(Race.E.arimaLib, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.LibLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaLib, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.lib <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.LibLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.lib <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.LibLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.lib <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.LibLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 # Note change because of drift
decomp.E.Race.lib <- decompose(race.WEts.Pol.lib)
p.ch.Race.E.lib <- (decomp.E.Race.lib$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.lib$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.lib$trend[7] 
r.ch.Race.E.lib <- decomp.E.Race.lib$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.lib$trend[114]

## Differenced series --------
race.WEts.diff.pol <- race.WEts.Pol.cons - race.WEts.Pol.lib
arima.Race.E.diff.pol <- auto.arima(race.WEts.diff.pol, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.diff.pol <- forecast(arima.Race.E.diff.pol, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.diff.polLONG <- forecast(arima.Race.E.diff.pol, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.pol.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.polLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
mean.Race.E.pol.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.polLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.pol.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.polLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.diff.pol[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.diff.pol <- decompose(race.WEts.diff.pol)
p.ch.Race.E.diff.pol <- (decomp.E.Race.diff.pol$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.diff.pol$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.diff.pol$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.diff.pol <- decomp.E.Race.diff.pol$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.diff.pol$trend[114]
```

## Education Differences.

```{r codeEducation, include=FALSE}
## Combine all data
race.WEts.Edu.ncolALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Edu.ncol, race.WEts.Edu.ncolNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEts.Edu.ncolALL <- ts(c(age.WEts.Edu.ncol, age.WEts.Edu.ncolNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Edu.ncolALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Edu.ncol, sex.WEts.Edu.ncolNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
race.WEts.Edu.colALL <- ts(c(race.WEts.Edu.col, race.WEts.Edu.colNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WEts.Edu.colALL <- ts(c(age.WEts.Edu.col, age.WEts.Edu.colNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Edu.colALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Edu.col, sex.WEts.Edu.colNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## RACE ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to > College
Race.E.arimaColl <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Edu.col, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.Coll <- forecast(Race.E.arimaColl, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.CollLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaColl, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.col <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.CollLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.col <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.CollLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.col <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.CollLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.Edu.col[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.col <- decompose(race.WEts.Edu.col)
p.ch.Race.E.col <- (decomp.E.Race.col$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.col$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.col$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.col <- decomp.E.Race.col$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.col$trend[114] 
## Fit to NColls
Race.E.arimaNColl <- auto.arima(race.WEts.Edu.ncol, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.NColl <- forecast(Race.E.arimaNColl, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.NCollLONG <- forecast(Race.E.arimaNColl, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.ncol <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.NCollLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.ncol <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.NCollLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.ncol <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.NCollLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.Edu.ncol[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.ncol <- decompose(race.WEts.Edu.ncol)
p.ch.Race.E.ncol <- (decomp.E.Race.ncol$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.ncol$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.ncol$trend[7] 
r.ch.Race.E.ncol <- decomp.E.Race.ncol$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.ncol$trend[114]

## Differenced series --------
race.WEts.diff.edu <- race.WEts.Edu.col - race.WEts.Edu.ncol
arima.Race.E.diff.edu <- auto.arima(race.WEts.diff.edu, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Race.diff.edu <- forecast(arima.Race.E.diff.edu, h = 60)
forecast.E.Race.diff.eduLONG <- forecast(arima.Race.E.diff.edu, h = 2400)
min.bound.Race.E.edu.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.eduLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Race.E.edu.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.eduLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Race.E.edu.diff <- min(which(forecast.E.Race.diff.eduLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WEts.diff.edu[1]))/12 
decomp.E.Race.diff.edu <- decompose(race.WEts.diff.edu)
p.ch.Race.E.diff.edu <- (decomp.E.Race.diff.edu$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.diff.edu$trend[114])/decomp.E.Race.diff.edu$trend[7]
r.ch.Race.E.diff.edu <- decomp.E.Race.diff.edu$trend[7] - decomp.E.Race.diff.edu$trend[114]

## SEXUALITY ------
## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Colls
Sex.E.arimaColl <- auto.arima(sex.WEts.Edu.col, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Sex.Coll <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaColl, h = 60)
forecast.E.Sex.CollLONG <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaColl, h = 2400)
min.bound.Sex.E.col <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.CollLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Sex.E.col <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.CollLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Sex.E.col <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.CollLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 # Note change because of drift.
decomp.E.Sex.col <- decompose(sex.WEts.Edu.col)
p.ch.Sex.E.col <- (decomp.E.Sex.col$trend[7] - decomp.E.Sex.col$trend[114])/decomp.E.Sex.col$trend[7]
r.ch.Sex.E.col <- decomp.E.Sex.col$trend[7] - decomp.E.Sex.col$trend[114] 
## Fit to NColls
Sex.E.arimaNColl <- auto.arima(sex.WEts.Edu.ncol, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Sex.NColl <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaNColl, h = 60)
forecast.E.Sex.NCollLONG <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaNColl, h = 2400)
min.bound.Sex.E.ncol <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.NCollLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.Sex.E.ncol <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.NCollLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.Sex.E.ncol <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.NCollLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=2*sex.WEts.Edu.col[1]))/12

age.WEts.diff.E.eduALL <- age.WEts.Edu.colALL - age.WEts.Edu.ncolALL
arima.age.diff.E.eduALL <- auto.arima(age.WEts.diff.E.eduALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.age.diff.E.eduALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.E.eduALL, h = 60)
forecast.age.diff.E.eduLONGALL <- forecast(arima.age.diff.E.eduALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.age.edu.diff.EALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.E.eduLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.age.edu.diff.EALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.E.eduLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.age.edu.diff.EALL <- min(which(forecast.age.diff.E.eduLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.WEts.diff.E.eduALL[1]))/12 
decomp.age.diff.E.eduALL <- decompose(age.WEts.diff.E.eduALL)
p.ch.age.diff.E.eduALL <- (decomp.age.diff.E.eduALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.E.eduALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.diff.E.eduALL$trend[7]
r.ch.age.diff.E.eduALL <- decomp.age.diff.E.eduALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.diff.E.eduALL$trend[162]
```

```{r codeAge, include=FALSE}
forecast.E.Sex.YoungLONGALL <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaYoungALL, h = 2400)
min.bound.sex.E.youngALL <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.YoungLONGALL$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.sex.E.youngALL <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.YoungLONGALL$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.sex.E.youngALL <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.YoungLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 # note switch because of drift
decomp.sex.E.youngALL <- decompose(sex.WEts.Age.youngALL)
p.ch.sex.E.youngALL <- (decomp.sex.E.youngALL$trend[7] - decomp.sex.E.youngALL$trend[162])/decomp.sex.E.youngALL$trend[7] 
r.ch.sex.E.youngALL <- decomp.sex.E.youngALL$trend[7] - decomp.sex.E.youngALL$trend[162]

max.bound.sex.age.diff.EALL <- min(which(forecast.sex.diff.E.ageALLLONGALL$upper[,"95%"]>=2*sex.WEts.diff.E.ageALL[1]))/12

r.ch.sex.diff.E.ageALL <- decomp.sex.diff.E.ageALL$trend[7] - decomp.sex.diff.E.ageALL$trend[162]

  exp.age.tableALL$arima.drift[i] <- ifelse(grepl("drift", exp.age.tableALL$arima.drift[i]), "drift", NA)
}

exp.age.tableALL$minfor <- round(c(min.bound.age.E.youngALL, min.bound.age.E.oldALL, min.bound.age.age.diff.EALL,
                             min.bound.race.E.youngALL, min.bound.race.E.oldALL, min.bound.race.age.diff.EALL,
                             min.bound.sex.E.youngALL, min.bound.sex.E.oldALL, min.bound.sex.age.diff.EALL),2)
for (i in 1:nrow(exp.age.tableALL)){
  exp.age.tableALL$minfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", exp.age.tableALL$minfor[i]), ">200 yrs", exp.age.tableALL$minfor[i])
}

exp.age.tableALL$meanfor <- round(c(mean.age.E.youngALL, mean.age.E.oldALL, mean.age.age.diff.EALL,
                             mean.race.E.youngALL, mean.race.E.oldALL, mean.race.age.diff.EALL,
                             mean.sex.E.youngALL, mean.sex.E.oldALL, mean.sex.age.diff.EALL),2)
for (i in 1:nrow(exp.age.tableALL)){
  exp.age.tableALL$meanfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", exp.age.tableALL$meanfor[i]), ">200 yrs", exp.age.tableALL$meanfor[i])
}

exp.age.tableALL$maxfor <- round(c(max.bound.age.E.youngALL, max.bound.age.E.oldALL, max.bound.age.age.diff.EALL,
                             max.bound.race.E.youngALL, max.bound.race.E.oldALL, max.bound.race.age.diff.EALL,
                             max.bound.sex.E.youngALL, max.bound.sex.E.oldALL, max.bound.sex.age.diff.EALL),2)
for (i in 1:nrow(exp.age.tableALL)){
  exp.age.tableALL$maxfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", exp.age.tableALL$maxfor[i]), ">200 yrs", exp.age.tableALL$maxfor[i])
}
```

```{r codeReligion, include=FALSE}
p.ch.age.E.otherALL <- (decomp.age.E.otherALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.E.otherALL$trend[162])/decomp.age.E.otherALL$trend[7] 
r.ch.age.E.otherALL <- decomp.age.E.otherALL$trend[7] - decomp.age.E.otherALL$trend[162]
## Fit to JewishALL
Age.E.arimaJewishALL <- auto.arima(age.WEts.Rel.jewishALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.Age.E.JewishALL <- forecast(Age.E.arimaJewishALL, h = 60)
forecast.Age.E.JewishALLLONG <- forecast(Age.E.arimaJewishALL, h = 2400)

mean.age.E.jewishALL <- min(which(forecast.Age.E.JewishALLLONG$mean<=0))/12

                                         max.bound.race.E.rel.diff1ALL, max.bound.race.E.rel.diff2ALL,
                             max.bound.sex.E.nonALL, max.bound.sex.E.jewishALL, max.bound.sex.E.otherALL,
                                         max.bound.sex.E.rel.diff1ALL, max.bound.sex.E.rel.diff2ALL),2)

for (i in 1:nrow(exp.rel.tableALL_extra)){
  exp.rel.tableALL_extra$maxfor[i] <- ifelse(grepl("Inf", exp.rel.tableALL_extra$maxfor[i]), ">200 yrs", exp.rel.tableALL_extra$maxfor[i])
}
```

## Sexuality Differences.

```{r codeSexuality, include=FALSE}
sex.WEts.Sex.strNEW <- sex.WEts.Sex.straightNEW # modify names to align with earlier codes
sex.WEts.Sex.lesgayNEW <- sex.WEts.Sex.lesgayNEW
sex.WEts.Sex.bisexNEW <- sex.WEts.Sex.otherNEW

sex.WEts.Sex.strALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Sex.str, sex.WEts.Sex.strNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Sex.lesgayALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Sex.lesgay, sex.WEts.Sex.lesgayNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WEts.Sex.bisexALL <- ts(c(sex.WEts.Sex.bisex, sex.WEts.Sex.bisexNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)

## Individual trajectories -------
## Fit to Straight
Sex.E.arimaStraight <- auto.arima(sex.WEts.Sex.str, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Sex.Straight <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaStraight, h = 60)
forecast.E.Sex.StraightLONG <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaStraight, h = 2400)
min.bound.E.Sex.str <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.StraightLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12
mean.E.sex.str <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.StraightLONG$mean<=0))/12
max.bound.E.Sex.str <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.StraightLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 # note switch because it has a drift parameter
decomp.E.sex.str <- decompose(sex.WEts.Sex.str)
p.ch.Sex.E.str <- (decomp.E.sex.str$trend[7] - decomp.E.sex.str$trend[114])/decomp.E.sex.str$trend[7]
r.ch.Sex.E.str <- decomp.E.sex.str$trend[7] - decomp.E.sex.str$trend[114] 
## Fit to Lesgays
Sex.E.arimaLesgay <- auto.arima(sex.WEts.Sex.lesgay, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Sex.Lesgay <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaLesgay, h = 60)
forecast.E.Sex.LesgayLONG <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaLesgay, h = 2400)
min.bound.E.Sex.lesgay <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.LesgayLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=2*sex.WEts.Sex.lesgay[1]))/12 # note switch because from below
mean.E.sex.lesgay <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.LesgayLONG$mean<=2*sex.WEts.Sex.lesgay[1]))/12
max.bound.E.Sex.lesgay <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.LesgayLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=0))/12 
decomp.E.sex.lesgay <- decompose(sex.WEts.Sex.lesgay)
p.ch.Sex.E.lesgay <- (decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[7] - decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[114])/decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[7] 
r.ch.Sex.E.lesgay <- decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[7] - decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[114]
## Fit to Bisexs
Sex.E.arimaBisex <- auto.arima(sex.WEts.Sex.bisex, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.E.Sex.Bisex <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaBisex, h = 60)
forecast.E.Sex.BisexLONG <- forecast(Sex.E.arimaBisex, h = 2400)

mean.E.sex.bisex <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.BisexLONG$mean<=2*sex.WEts.Sex.bisex[1]))/12
max.bound.E.Sex.bisex <- min(which(forecast.E.Sex.BisexLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=0))/12  # note switch because it is from below

p.ch.Sex.E.bisex <- (decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[7] - decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[114])/decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[7] 
r.ch.Sex.E.bisex <- decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[7] - decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[114]

## Differenced series --------

arima.sex.E.diff.strlesgay <- auto.arima(sex.WEts.diff.strlesgay, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)

## Save all in a table ----------

exp.sexuality.table <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 5, ncol = 12))
colnames(exp.sexuality.table) <- c("att", "grp", "start", "end", "pch", "rch", "arima.pdq", "arima.pdqS", "arima.drift", "minfor", "meanfor", "maxfor")
exp.sexuality.table$att <- rep(c("Sexuality"), each = 5)
exp.sexuality.table$grp <- c("Straight", "Lesbian/Gay", "Bisexual", 
                                 "Straight - Lesbian/Gay", "Straight - Bisexual")

exp.sexuality.table$start <- round(c(decomp.E.sex.str$trend[7], decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[7], decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[7],
                            decomp.E.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[7], decomp.E.sex.diff.strbisex$trend[7]), 2) 
exp.sexuality.table$end <- round(c(decomp.E.sex.str$trend[114], decomp.E.sex.lesgay$trend[114], decomp.E.sex.bisex$trend[114],
                            decomp.E.sex.diff.strlesgay$trend[114], decomp.E.sex.diff.strbisex$trend[114]), 2) 

exp.sexuality.table$pch <- round(c(p.ch.Sex.E.str, p.ch.Sex.E.lesgay, p.ch.Sex.E.bisex, 
                          p.ch.Sex.E.diff.strlesgay, p.ch.Sex.E.diff.strbisex)*100, 2)

exp.sexuality.table$rch <- round(c(r.ch.Sex.E.str, r.ch.Sex.E.lesgay, r.ch.Sex.E.bisex, 
                          r.ch.Sex.E.diff.strlesgay, r.ch.Sex.E.diff.strbisex), 2)

exp.sexuality.table$arima.pdq <- c(paste(arimaorder(Sex.E.arimaStraight)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.E.arimaLesgay)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.E.arimaBisex)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.E.diff.strlesgay)[1:3], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.E.diff.strbisex)[1:3], collapse = ","))

exp.sexuality.table$arima.pdqS <- c(paste(arimaorder(Sex.E.arimaStraight)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.E.arimaLesgay)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(Sex.E.arimaBisex)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.E.diff.strlesgay)[4:6], collapse = ","),
                              paste(arimaorder(arima.sex.E.diff.strbisex)[4:6], collapse = ","))
```

``` {r demographicAccuracies, echo = FALSE}
                     "racechristian", "racejewish", "racenonreligious", "raceotherreligion",
                     "raceconservative", "raceliberal",
                     "sexualityfemale", "sexualitymale", "sexualitywhite", "sexualityblack", "sexualityasian",
                     "sexualitycollege", "sexualitynocollege", "sexualityyoung", "sexualityold",
                     "sexualitychristian", "sexualityjewish", "sexualitynonreligious", "sexualityotherreligion",
                     "sexualityconservative", "sexualityliberal",
                     "sexualitybi", "sexualitylesgay", "sexualitystr")

# Create a TS matrix of NEW data (to be tested against)
tsmatNEW_exp <- matrix(c(age.WEts.Gen.femNEW, age.WEts.Gen.malNEW, age.WEts.Race.whiteNEW, age.WEts.Race.blackNEW, age.WEts.Race.asianNEW,
                  age.WEts.Edu.colNEW, age.WEts.Edu.ncolNEW, age.WEts.Age.youngNEW, age.WEts.Age.oldNEW,
                  age.WEts.Rel.christianNEW, age.WEts.Rel.jewishNEW, age.WEts.Rel.nonNEW, age.WEts.Rel.otherNEW,
                  age.WEts.Pol.consNEW, age.WEts.Pol.libNEW,
                  race.WEts.Gen.femNEW, race.WEts.Gen.malNEW, race.WEts.Race.whiteNEW, race.WEts.Race.blackNEW, race.WEts.Race.asianNEW,
                  race.WEts.Edu.colNEW, race.WEts.Edu.ncolNEW, race.WEts.Age.youngNEW, race.WEts.Age.oldNEW,
                  race.WEts.Rel.christianNEW, race.WEts.Rel.jewishNEW, race.WEts.Rel.nonNEW, race.WEts.Rel.otherNEW,
                  race.WEts.Pol.consNEW, race.WEts.Pol.libNEW,
                  sex.WEts.Gen.femNEW, sex.WEts.Gen.malNEW, sex.WEts.Race.whiteNEW, sex.WEts.Race.blackNEW, sex.WEts.Race.asianNEW,
                  sex.WEts.Edu.colNEW, sex.WEts.Edu.ncolNEW, sex.WEts.Age.youngNEW, sex.WEts.Age.oldNEW,
                  sex.WEts.Rel.christianNEW, sex.WEts.Rel.jewishNEW, sex.WEts.Rel.nonNEW, sex.WEts.Rel.otherNEW,
                  sex.WEts.Pol.consNEW, sex.WEts.Pol.libNEW, sex.WEts.Sex.bisexNEW, sex.WEts.Sex.lesgayNEW, sex.WEts.Sex.strNEW),
                nrow = 48)
colnames(tsmatNEW_exp) <- c("agefemale", "agemale", "agewhite", "ageblack", "ageasian",
                     "agecollege", "agenocollege", "ageyoung", "ageold",
                     "agechristian", "agejewish", "agenonreligious", "ageotherreligion",
                     "ageconservative", "ageliberal",
                     "racefemale", "racemale", "racewhite", "raceblack", "raceasian",
                     "racecollege", "racenocollege", "raceyoung", "raceold",
                     "racechristian", "racejewish", "racenonreligious", "raceotherreligion",
                     "raceconservative", "raceliberal",
                     "sexualityfemale", "sexualitymale", "sexualitywhite", "sexualityblack", "sexualityasian",
                     "sexualitycollege", "sexualitynocollege", "sexualityyoung", "sexualityold",
                     "sexualitychristian", "sexualityjewish", "sexualitynonreligious", "sexualityotherreligion",
                     "sexualityconservative", "sexualityliberal",
                     "sexualitybi", "sexualitylesgay", "sexualitystr")


## Fit arima models and forecasts by column on training set
tsmat_arimas_exp <- list()
tsmat_forecast_exp <- list()
tsmat_accuracy_exp <- list()
ts_rmse_exp <- vector()
ts_mase_exp <- vector()
ts_mae_exp <- vector()
ts_Nin80_exp <- vector()
ts_Nin95_exp <- vector()

for(i in 1:dim(tsmat_exp)[2]){ # loop over columns in matrix
  tsmat_arimas_exp[[i]] <- auto.arima(tsmat_exp[,i], approximation = FALSE, stepwise = FALSE) # fit ARIMA
  tsmat_forecast_exp[[i]] <- forecast(tsmat_arimas_exp[[i]], h = 48) # pull out forecast_exp for horizon of 4 years
  tsmat_accuracy_exp[[i]] <- accuracy(tsmat_forecast_exp[[i]], tsmatNEW_exp[,i])
  ts_rmse_exp[i] <- tsmat_accuracy_exp[[i]]["Test set","RMSE"]
  ts_mase_exp[i] <- tsmat_accuracy_exp[[i]]["Test set","MASE"]
  ts_mae_exp[i] <- tsmat_accuracy_exp[[i]]["Test set","MAE"]
  ts_Nin80_exp[i] <- as.numeric(table(tsmatNEW_exp[,i] < tsmat_forecast_exp[[i]]$upper[,1] & 
                                    tsmatNEW_exp[,i] > tsmat_forecast_exp[[i]]$lower[,1]))[2]
  ts_Nin95_exp[i] <- as.numeric(table(tsmatNEW_exp[i] < tsmat_forecast_exp[[i]]$upper[,2] &
                                    tsmatNEW_exp[i] > tsmat_forecast_exp[[i]]$lower[,2]))[2]
  ts_Nin95_exp <- ifelse(is.na(ts_Nin95_exp), 48, ts_Nin95_exp)
  print(i)
}


## Save all in a table ----
demog.acc.table_exp <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 48, ncol = 9))
colnames(demog.acc.table_exp) <- c("att", "group", "MASE", "MAE", "RMSE", 
                            "Nin80", "Nin95", "Pin80", "Pin95")
demog.acc.table_exp$att <- c(rep(c("Age", "Race", "Sexuality"), each = 15), rep("Sexuality", each = 3))
demog.acc.table_exp$group <- c(rep(c("Female", "Male", "White", "Black", "Asian", ">College", "<College", "Young", "Old",
                "Christian", "Jewish", "Non-religious", "Other religion", "Conservative", "Liberal"), times = 3),
                "Bisexual", "Lesbian/Gay", "Straight")
demog.acc.table_exp$MASE <- round(c(ts_mase_exp), 2) 
demog.acc.table_exp$MAE <- round(c(ts_mae_exp), 2) 
demog.acc.table_exp$RMSE <- round(c(ts_rmse_exp), 2) 
demog.acc.table_exp$Nin80 <- c(ts_Nin80_exp)
demog.acc.table_exp$Nin95 <- c(ts_Nin95_exp)
demog.acc.table_exp$Pin80 <- (c(ts_Nin80_exp)/48)*100
demog.acc.table_exp$Pin95 <- (c(ts_Nin95_exp)/48)*100
```
